column1: # Authoritative aggregate invariant status. README audit verdicts are a checked projection.
# REFUTED_CURRENT means at least one current-pin counterexample names the invariant as primary.
# OPEN_EVIDENCE means a current counterexample invalidates the claimed coverage composition.
# SUPPORTED means bounded/conditional evidence exists and no registered counterexample currently falsifies it.
# PROVEN requires TRANSITION_SYSTEM + FULL_DOMAIN evidence, no assumptions, and no counterexamples.
# GLOBAL_CONDITIONAL_TCB is a conservative ceiling: SVM rollback and authenticated inputs are TCB;
# arithmetic equivalence is empirical; fair submission and required-role availability remain open assumptions.
